messages:
maria: :rotating_light: paging oncall — multiple alerts for serving runtime crashloops and node flaps in eu-west-1. Customers reporting 503s and token latency spiking.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT CREATED (P2) - 1805550123 - /incidents - Autoscale oscillation -> crashloops

maria: seeing repeated CUDA OOM in runtime pods, followed by kubelet evicting and restarting. Autoscaler keeps scaling back up and then pods crash again.

sree: checking cluster autoscaler logs now. might be HPA + node autoscaler fighting each other. pulling logs: 
```
I0310 11:20:34.123 node_autoscaler.go:120] Node group scale up triggered: desired=8 current=4
W0310 11:20:36.004 eviction.go:78] Pod runtime-xyz OOMKilled by kernel: CUDA out of memory
I0310 11:20:40.004 node_autoscaler.go:145] Node group scale down candidate detected
```

daniel: runtime logs show repeated KV cache growth after rollout 2026-03-10. Some requests with long sequence lengths causing GPU mem blowout. Here are excerpts:
```
[2026-03-10T11:20:33Z] ERR CUDA: out of memory while allocating 512MB for attention_kv
[2026-03-10T11:20:33Z] INFO restarting process due to OOM
```

kevin: customers hit increased 5xxs. CS queue showing spike for accounts: acme-inc, adsys, mobile-chat-prod. Lex is triaging.

lex: pinging top affected customers. letting them know we're investigating; ETA unknown. collecting request samples from logs for root cause.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause cluster autoscaler 2) set HPA min replicas to current stable 3) scale up node size (larger GPU type) or reduce per-pod GPU request 4) roll back latest runtime image if needed. Thoughts?

daniel: agree. also we can enable prefix cache eviction to limit KV growth quickly (hotfix flag). I can push a config toggle to runtime configstore.

sree: I'll pause autoscaler and set nodegroups to fixed size to stop oscillation.

ops-bot: @maria has claimed the incident.

maria: running commands to pause autoscaler and patch hpa:
```
# cordon autoscaler manipulator
kubectl -n kube-system scale deploy cluster-autoscaler --replicas=0
# set HPA min to 6 to preserve capacity
kubectl -n serving patch hpa/llm-runtime -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 6}}'
```

maria: also cordoning small gpu pool nodes to force placement on larger nodes:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-small-*-eu1
kubectl drain node/gpu-small-*-eu1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

daniel: pushed runtime config flag to evict large KV entries after 30s idle. restarting one pod to validate.

maria: restarting pod runtime-7c4 to pick up config.

runtime-7c4 logs:
```
INFO config: kv_eviction_seconds=30
INFO starting
WARN previous run had OOM at seq_len=2048
```

daniel: restarted 4/6 pods, memory footprint dropped ~30% on those.

sree: autoscaler paused. nodegroups fixed at 8 nodes. observing no more immediate scale down events.

kevin: latency and 5xxs trending down for most customers; still monitoring acme-inc. sending update to status page.

lex: sent customer message: "We're mitigating an autoscaling oscillation causing runtime restarts. We've applied a temporary configuration change and paused autoscaling. We will follow up with post-incident report." :thumbsup:

maria: rolling back the recent image could be next step if instability continues. daniel, do you think we need rollback?

daniel: if the KV growth fix keeps memory stable we can avoid rollback. keep it as option. I'm preparing a controlled rollback playbook if needed.

ops-bot: alert: new node flaps detected in eu-west-1 (3 nodes NotReady) — investigating

sree: those were small nodes we cordoned; they started kube-proxy thrashing during drain -> causing NotReady. I've isolated and force-terminated the problematic instances in the ASG. replacing with fresh nodes.

maria: summary so far: autoscaler paused, HPA min=6, KV eviction enabled, cordoned small GPU pool, node replacements in progress. Visible customer impact reduced.

daniel: also found one misconfigured pod in the runtime deployment requesting full device memory with no limits; patched to request 0.6 GPU instead of 1.0. That reduced packing pressure.

kevin: support update: backlog down to 12 tickets from 48, most customers acknowledged the update.

maria: monitoring for 30 minutes. if stable we'll unpause autoscaler with stricter cooldowns and higher min replicas. action items for post-mortem: 1) tune HPA/autoscaler interplay, 2) add admission check to prevent pods requesting full GPU without limits, 3) add KV eviction as a safety default, 4) better rollout gate for runtime changes.

lex: noted. prepping customer-facing incident summary for tomorrow.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - severity downgraded to P3 - 1805550123

maria: handing off to daniel for night watch. daniel, can you take it? I'll add you to incident oncall and pass context.

daniel: taking handoff. will keep an eye overnight and escalate if OOMs reappear. thanks.

maria: thanks everyone. ending active paging loop. :white_check_mark:

kevin: filed a follow-up internal ticket to track affected customers and credits if needed.

maria: closing thread for now. will attach logs and timeline to the postmortem doc.
